## Example 7.7 · (a–b) {#iv7-example-7-7-ab .vector-lesson .projection-lesson .pr-compact}

```{=html}
<p>Given the vectors <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=4\underset{\sim}{i}+5\underset{\sim}{j}-3\underset{\sim}{k}"></span> and <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}=2\underset{\sim}{i}-2\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k}"></span>, find</p><div class="pr-cols"><div><p>a) the scalar projection of <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}"></span> onto <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="pr-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=4(2)+5(-2)+(-3)(1)=-5"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle |\underset{\sim}{b}|=\sqrt{2^2+(-2)^2+1^2}=3"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \frac{\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}}{|\underset{\sim}{b}|}=-\frac53"></span></div></div></div></div><div><p>b) the vector projection of <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}"></span> onto <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="pr-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \operatorname{proj}_{\underset{\sim}{b}}\underset{\sim}{a}=\frac{\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}}{|\underset{\sim}{b}|^2}\underset{\sim}{b}"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =-\frac59(2\underset{\sim}{i}-2\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k})"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =-\frac{10}{9}\underset{\sim}{i}+\frac{10}{9}\underset{\sim}{j}-\frac59\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
```
